options.name: cts.skip_fanout_le
options.help: gated clock nets of at most N loads are left to their gate (the recipe key cts_skip_fanout_le)

options.name: cts.gate_sizing
options.help: size each clock gate by the clock arrival it gives (the recipe key cts_size_gates)

options.name: cts.gate_drive_re
options.help: regular expression with three groups (prefix, drive, suffix) of a clock-gate cell name; required with cts.gate_sizing

options.name: cts.gate_drives
options.help: candidate clock-gate drives, space separated; required with cts.gate_sizing

options.name: cts.gate_size_tolerance
options.help: clock-gate sizing: prefer the first listed drive within this of the fastest; required with cts.gate_sizing

options.name: cts.gate_port_tol
options.help: clock-gate sizing tolerance for the gates that clock a register in the fan-in of an output port (unset: cts.gate_size_tolerance)

options.name: cts.gate_variants
options.help: other variants of a clock-gate cell to try (replacing the match of cts.gate_variant_re)

options.name: cts.gate_variant_re
options.help: regular expression of the variant part of a clock-gate cell name

options.name: cts.gate_report
options.help: print every clock gate's candidate arrivals

options.name: cts.flatten_root
options.help: remove the root clock buffer (1: a lone root buffer; all: every buffer the port drives)

options.name: cts.repair_dont_use
options.help: space separated regular expressions of cells the post-clock-tree repair must not use

options.name: pnr.spef_restore_pincap
options.help: restore the pin capacitance the global-route SPEF estimate leaves out

options.name: pnr.flow.hold_margin
options.help: hold repair margin of the command's P&R flow

options.name: pnr.flow.setup_margin
options.help: setup repair margin of the command's P&R flow

options.name: pnr.floorplan.utilization
options.help: core utilization of the floorplan

options.name: pnr.floorplan.aspect_ratio
options.help: aspect ratio of the core

options.name: pnr.floorplan.core_margin
options.help: margin between core and die

options.name: pnr.floorplan.place_density
options.help: target placement density

options.name: pnr.floorplan.cell_padding
options.help: placement padding around each cell

options.name: pnr.top_override
options.help: name of the top module, when it is not the netlist's first module

options.name: pnr.post_route_repair
options.help: run a timing repair after routing

options.name: pnr.max_utilization
options.help: utilization limit of the post-route repair

options.name: pnr.recipe_dir
options.help: the directory the command reads its recipe files from (the session sets it to the pack's when an option that needs it is set)

options.name: hold.corner
options.help: time hold at the pack's hold corner (the recipe key hold_corner)

options.name: pnr.file_roots
options.help: extra directories (':'-separated) under which files named by options may be found

options.name: post.margin_ps
options.help: post-layout setup margin (the flow option post.margin_ps)

options.name: post.fix
options.help: post-layout fix: bulk or sens (the flow option post.fix)

options.name: post.flop_cap
options.help: ladder token above which the post-layout swap never moves a flop (the flow option post.flop_cap)

options.name: run.ladder.mode
options.help: closure ladder: parallel or sequential rungs (the flow option run.ladder.mode)

options.name: run.ladder.fresh
options.help: closure ladder: start from no earlier placement or rung record (the flow option run.ladder.fresh)

options.name: run.partition
options.help: scheduler partition of the command's jobs (run mechanics)

options.name: run.rung_cpus
options.help: CPUs of a P&R job (run mechanics)

options.name: run.rung_mem
options.help: memory of a P&R job (run mechanics)

options.name: run.rung_time
options.help: time limit of a P&R job (run mechanics)

options.name: report.area_digits
options.help: decimal digits of stdcell_area in pnr_metrics.json

options.name: report.cell_histogram
options.help: also write cell_histogram.json (instances per cell)

options.name: report.label
options.help: a label written to report.json

options.name: report.note
options.help: a file of the recipe directory whose first line is written to report.json
